goal: Build a Python standard-library inventory application with main.py as entrypoint and any additional source modules. It reads UTF-8 JSON objects, one per stdin line, and prints exactly one JSON response per line with no log text on stdout. Store inventory using SQLite under /tmp/inventory.db. Each fresh process starts with no data; preserve state across requests in that process. Operation list returns {ok:true,items:[{sku,quantity}]} sorted by sku. Operation add takes a nonempty string sku and an integer quantity between 0 and 9223372036854775807 inclusive (booleans are invalid), upserts that SKU to the supplied quantity and returns {ok:true,sku,quantity}. Invalid SKU, quantity outside this range or noninteger quantity, or unknown operation returns {ok:false,error:"invalid_item"} without changing stored data. Handle each input independently and continue after invalid requests. Do not access network or paths outside /tmp and read-only application sources. Container has Python standard library only; do not add installation steps.
